name: Claude
description: Lets an operator ask a model to draft a ticket reply or summarise a thread. Nothing is ever sent to a customer: every draft lands in the box somebody was going to type in. What leaves this installation is the ticket's subject, the customer's name and the conversation — never an internal note, a tax id or a credential.

config.label: Model
config.hint: Which model answers. A smaller one is cheaper and is usually enough for a summary.

config.label: API address
config.hint: Leave as it is unless you route through a proxy of your own.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.hint: A draft is written while somebody waits, so this is short on purpose. If it runs out, write the reply yourself.
